@class:     Channeling Alchemist

 1 | Work Cloth | self | 24 hrs | self | F
 2 | Work Leather | self | 24 hrs | self | F
 3 | Work Wood | self | 24 hrs | self | F

 5 | Work Organic | self | 24 hrs | self | F
 6 | Vestments of Combat | 1 vestment | 1 min/lvl | touch | Fv
 7 | Make Wand | self | 24 hrs | self | F
 8 | Holy Water I | 4 oz. | P | touch | Fv
10 | Make Rod | self | 24 hrs | self | F

12 | Holy Water II | 4 oz. | P | touch | Fv
13 | Exorcism | 1 target | P | 20' | Fv
15 | Make Staff | self | 24 hours | self | F
16 | Dismissal | 1 target | P | 100' | Fv
18 | Work Magic Cloth | self | 24 hrs | self | F
19 | Work Magic Leather | self | 24 hrs | self | F
20 | Work Magic Wood | self | 24 hrs | self | F
25 | Work Magic Organic True | self | 24 hrs | self | F
30 | Holy Water III | 4 oz. | P | touch | Fv
50 | Holy Water True | 20 oz. | P | touch | Fv

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Allows caster to flawlessly fabricate and fashion non-magical cloth. All
required tools and materials must be present. The time to work the material is
halved.
@@ 2
Allows caster to flawlessly create non-magical leather (from animal skins).
All required tools and materials must be present. The time to work the
material is halved.
@@ 3
Allows caster to flawlessly work non-magical wood. All required tools and
materials must be present. The time to work the material is halved.
@@ 4
Consecrates vestment for usage of many spells on this list.
@@ 5
Allows caster to work any non-magical organic material (e.g., horn, bone,
chitin, wax, feathers, hair, etc.). All required tools and materials must be
present. The time to work the material is halved.
@@ 6
The target’s vestment becomes AT 3 with a +10 DB modification. For the
duration of the spell the vestment cannot be soiled as all dirt, blood, etc.,
will sheet off. Will not clear an dirty vestment.
@@ 7
Allows caster to make a “wand” which may be imbedded in it using Essence,
Mentalism, Channeling, or Arcane.
@@ 8
Converts 4 oz. of clear spring water to holy water. Holy water is used for
ceremonies and to combat Undead. Undead take a‘B’ heat critical (or some other
type, GM discretion, if the creature is immune to Heat criticals) when
splashed. The water should be stored in fine crystal vials intended
specifically for holy water storage.
@@ 10
Allows caster to make a “rod” which may be imbedded in it using Essence,
Mentalism, Channeling, or Arcane.
@@ 11
As Vestments of Combat, except the vestment is treated as AT 4 with a +20 DB
modification.
@@ 12
As Holy Water I, except the holy water inflicts a ‘C’ critical against Undead.
@@ 13
Dismisses a demon from a person or structure for 100-1000 years. Requires 4
oz. holy water. Multiple possessions must be removed one by one. Demons get an
RR.
@@ 15
Allows caster to make a “staff” which may be imbedded in it using Essence,
Mentalism, Channeling, or Arcane.
@@ 16
As Exorcism, except that there is a -20 RR modification and the demon is
dismissed for 200-1200 years. If the demon resists the spell, a spell failure
results with the roll being modified by the amount saved + the spell level. If
the demon does not resist, the caster learns the name of the demon and may ask
it a question which it must answer truthfully.
@@ 18
Allows caster to flawlessly fabricate and fashion magical cloth. All required
tools and materials must be present. The time to work the material is halved.
@@ 19
Allows caster to flawlessly create magical leather (from animal skins). All
required tools and materials must be present. The time to work the material is
halved.
@@ 20
Allows caster to flawlessly work magical wood. All required tools and
materials must be present. The time to work the material is halved.
@@ 25
Allows caster to work any magical organic material (e.g., horn, bone, chitin,
wax, feathers, hair, etc.). All required tools and materials must be present.
The time to work the material is halved.
@@ 30
As Holy Water I, except the holy water inflicts a ‘D’ critical against Undead.
@@ 50
As Holy Water I, except the holy water inflicts a ‘E’ critical against Undead.
This spell also allows the Alchemist to produce five vials of holy water at
one time.
